resources.name: HGH norm-conserving pseudopotential for Na

access.notes: Publicly available from ABINIT pseudopotential library. Required in the standard format readable by plane-wave DFT codes.

resources.notes: Must be the norm-conserving HGH pseudopotential for sodium as used in the method.

access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code (e.g., ABINIT, Quantum ESPRESSO) capable of local Kohn-Sham solves, LOBPCG eigensolver, and output of total energies. The agent may use any such code.
